nodes.label: Inline motion-pending hero guard
nodes.rationale: Hides hero briefly so the GSAP intro can play; auto-reveals after 2.5s and is skipped for prefers-reduced-motion.

nodes.label: Google Fonts (DM Sans, DM Serif Display, Plus Jakarta Sans)
nodes.norm_label: google fonts (dm sans, dm serif display, plus jakarta sans)

nodes.label: Service offerings (websites, API integration, custom software, AI chatbots, hosting)
nodes.norm_label: service offerings (websites, api integration, custom software, ai chatbots, hosting)

nodes.label: Motion (GSAP 3.15)
nodes.rationale: All animation in motion.js using gsap, ScrollTrigger and SplitText vendored into assets/vendor/. Intro, mouse and scroll effects; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion and the page degrades gracefully if GSAP fails to load.

nodes.label: FAQ Section
nodes.rationale: Native details/summary answers on project cost, post-launch care, AI chatbots, and improving existing systems.

nodes.label: Hero Section
nodes.rationale: Headline 'Your big idea. Built for the real world.' with CTAs (Get a free quote, Explore services) and an animated browser-window mock.

nodes.label: Homepage (index.html)
nodes.rationale: Single-page site for DelcoTech Software & AI Solutions (South Africa, en-ZA) with canonical https://delcotech.co.za/, OG tags and VideoObject JSON-LD.

nodes.label: Pricing Section (tailored quotes)
nodes.rationale: Three groups populated by JS: build website/system (#build-list), add AI (#ai-list), optional monthly hosting and care plans (#plan-list).

nodes.label: Services Section
nodes.rationale: Service cards rendered into #services-list by JavaScript; covers websites, API integrations, custom software, chatbots and custom AI, hosting and care.

nodes.label: robots.txt crawl policy
nodes.rationale: Allows all crawlers on all paths.

nodes.label: Bot knowledge base (src/knowledge.js)
nodes.rationale: Services, prices, FAQ and contact details the bot knows; must be kept in step with CONFIG in script.js and redeployed.

nodes.label: Worker Setup (wrangler login, secret, deploy)
nodes.rationale: Create OpenAI key with billing and spend limit, npx wrangler login, wrangler secret put OPENAI_API_KEY, wrangler deploy, then paste the workers.dev URL into CHAT_ENDPOINT in chatbot.js.

nodes.label: CONFIG object in script.js
nodes.rationale: Holds whatsapp and email settings and editable site content (pricing, services, steps).

nodes.label: Before Go-Live Checklist
nodes.rationale: Set real WhatsApp number and email in CONFIG, verify pricing/terms (50% deposit, two revision rounds, VAT), brand name, test enquiry, and confirm POPIA privacy notice. Placeholder contact details from the original site are deliberately left blank.

nodes.label: DelcoTech Chat Backend (Cloudflare Worker)
nodes.rationale: Keeps the OpenAI API key secret, injects DelcoTech business info into every chat, only accepts requests from delcotech.co.za, and rate-limits visitors to 10 messages per minute.

nodes.label: 3D Tools (Three.js)
nodes.rationale: tools3d.js renders six service-card models (laptop, chip, chat bubble, browser window, nodes, shield) that react to mouse/hover; feature3d.js renders the 3D DelcoTech logo in the About circle. Only on-screen models are drawn; icons shown without WebGL.

nodes.label: Accessibility and Maintenance
nodes.rationale: Skip link, labelled fields, keyboard menu, focus states, native FAQ disclosure, reduced-motion support, search/social metadata, Google Fonts with system fallback.

nodes.label: How Enquiries Work (WhatsApp / email / copy fallback)
nodes.norm_label: how enquiries work (whatsapp / email / copy fallback)
nodes.rationale: Static site with no server: opens WhatsApp prefilled, else mailto, else copy-only preview. Form stores nothing and transmits no data to a server.

nodes.label: Project Files Inventory
nodes.rationale: Lists index.html, style.css, script.js, motion.js, tools3d.js, feature3d.js, assets/vendor/three (Three.js 0.186), GSAP vendor files and favicon.

nodes.label: Quick Start (static hosting)
nodes.rationale: Open index.html in a browser or upload the folder contents to public_html / any static-site host.

nodes.label: Enquiry Form (#enquiry)
nodes.rationale: Fields: name, email/phone, project type (including AI chatbot or custom AI), details; has Send enquiry, Send via Email and copy-message fallback.

nodes.label: DelcoTech Website README
nodes.rationale: Setup and maintenance guide for the static DelcoTech Software & AI Solutions site; no npm, build tools, API keys or backend needed to run it.

nodes.label: Worker Settings (origins, rate limit, model, logs)
nodes.norm_label: worker settings (origins, rate limit, model, logs)

nodes.label: Changing the Site (file responsibilities)
nodes.rationale: Content/pricing/contacts live in script.js, design in style.css, structure/FAQ/metadata in index.html.

nodes.label: Promo film assets (See it in action)
nodes.norm_label: promo film assets (see it in action)
nodes.rationale: Landscape mp4 + poster for desktop/tablet, vertical mp4 + poster for phones; script.js picks the variant; replace files keeping same names to update.

nodes.label: Showreel Section (See it in action)
nodes.rationale: About one-minute promo film with phone-specific vertical source swapped via data-phone-src attributes.
